svg.title: The 808 — South Knoxville parking map
svg.desc: Editable vector map traced from the user-supplied 1105 x 520 map screenshot. Road and building silhouettes preserve the reference image coordinate system and aspect ratio. Parking symbols are annotations, not surveyed parcel boundaries. Borderland Tees is marked west of The 808. This is a screenshot-derived cartographic proof, not an independently georeferenced GIS or cadastral export.

g.inkscape:label: 07 West-side detail and notes
g.text: Green curb marks indicate street parking—not whole streets.
Follow posted signs and resident-permit restrictions.
The private lot immediately west of The 808 is not venue parking.
Parking locations from the supplied brief; fees, hours and availability may change.
Screenshot-traced map • lot symbols show approximate locations, not property boundaries.
Enlarged from the same vector map • no mirrored or relocated streets
